assumptions: SIGNAL IS BACK AT DESIGN 4.1 (the lead's instruction; spec History 2026-11-14, built). The item is written removing when rules 1 to 6 have passed and before its remover is called. Row signal/removing-while-the-remover-runs: the remover sees the item removing, the journal grows by signal, removing and removed; a process killed inside the remover leaves the item removing with the event and the emitter recorded; when the ledger refuses that write the remover is not handed the item. Falsifier space345-due-while-the-remover-runs turns the row red. Suite 139 runs the keeper itself since this change.

THE LEDGER READS THE KEEP RECORD ITSELF. Row keep/ledger-reads-itself: a ref the repository does not hold or holds at another commit, a ref outside the item's own, a repository the declarations do not name or named through .., a snapshot path outside the store, written with .., or a link, a missing folder and a manifest with another digest are each refused by name with nothing written; neither host principal may sign keep; a later write adds and never moves. This is not a criterion of the spec; it is the keep command of design 6.1.

NOT PROVEN ON A REAL FULL DISK OR BY A REAL KILL. A full pool is the keeper's own write replaced for one attempt (it writes half a block and raises no space left, or returns short); a kill is an exception no handler catches, raised at the named point in the suite's own process. No process was sent a signal and no filesystem was filled.

TWO FALSIFIERS ARE APPLIED IN A NARROWER FORM (spec History 2026-11-14, built). The agent worktree's refs in its agent repository is stopped by the ledger's own check one step before the loss. The snapshot as a commit on a kept ref is applied as its files written into the main repository's object store.

RECONCILE IS NOT BUILT (VELDO-0315). "By reconcile" in AC3 is shown by control_space_keep.verify, the check reconcile must pass before it completes an item, and by a second attempt made the way reconcile will make it. The snapshot is written only when the keeper is made with snapshot=True; the removals that ask for one are VELDO-0318, 0336 and 0347, and no remover here forces a removal.
The full gate, the heavy suites and the teeth stage were not run by the builder.

A KEPT REF IS NEVER MOVED, AND EVERY ATTEMPT WRITES ITS OWN (spec History 2026-11-14). The name holds the attempt's number, <item>/<attempt>/<what>. An attempt whose refs the newest attempt already holds writes nothing; any other writes its whole set under the next number. An item tried many times with something changed each time gains one set of refs per attempt; they cost nothing and only the owner's drop takes them (VELDO-0346, whose History names the new names). commit and tree name the first build (0ceda28f); this change is in the commit that carries this bundle, made as one commit with the fix of VELDO-0301 by the lead's instruction.
The registered case space331-signal-reads-no-mode is anchored again and red (proof/VELDO-0301/mutations.txt).

THE REVIEW FIX (review-veldo-0345.md, verdict FIX, findings 1 to 4; spec History 2026-11-14). It is in the commit that carries this bundle; commit and tree still name the first build (0ceda28f). The keep record gained a field, attempt {number, head}: the Ledger clears it when the item becomes due or removing and a keep write sets it, the outcome removed is refused as space_keep_stale while it is clear, and verify also reads the item's tips now. The Ledger reads the item's HEAD itself and requires it as the kept head of the write's attempt. Saved files keep their permission bits. The folders of the store are synced into the folder above them.

WHAT THE REVIEW FIX DOES NOT PROVE. The syncs are shown as calls made in the right order on the right folders (device and inode); no power was cut and no filesystem without ordered metadata was used. In the store the owner's read bit is always set and set-id and sticky bits never are: for a file without the owner's read bit, or with one of those bits, the manifest holds the mode and a plain copy does not; restore from the manifest is VELDO-0346. An attempt written before this change (files of mode 0600) reads as missing and is saved again under the next number. The Ledger reads the item's HEAD at its locator only: a keep write for an item that is under its marked name is refused as space_keep_item, and the keeper itself reads the item at its locator. The ledger's check at removed is the attempt on the record; it cannot read an item that is gone, so a commit made between the keep record and the remove is the remover's last look (VELDO-0300) and verify, not the ledger.

The reviewer ran a real kernel short write (RLIMIT_FSIZE) and a real SIGKILL at the three kill points against the first build and found nothing lost (review-veldo-0345.md, Tests run). Those runs are the reviewer's and were not repeated here; the suite's own full pool and kill are still stand-ins.
rollback: Revert the change. Removers then run without the keep step, as before this ticket. Kept refs already written stay in their repositories and are still read by plain git.
